# Fixtures for `shortcut` (Apple Shortcuts / Automator)

Files made for whiff's tests, CC0-1.0, for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour) with fixed times; names, devices, teams and addresses (`example.org`) are fictitious. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/apple.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `Harbour Tides.shortcut` | plutil -convert binary1 of a hand-written shortcut (no script actions) | CC0-1.0 |
| `document.wflow` | Written by hand (Automator workflow), checked with `plutil -lint` | CC0-1.0 |
